select * from DW.FactLoansCreditLimit where accountid = '43716a0298c1cd3da3f9be8afc17664a' order by businessdatesk desc

with CurrencyConversion
AS(
    SELECT * FROM BNKM.CurrencyConversion_FillGapDates WHERE ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' AND RateId = 'REV'
)
, GetMinMaxDate AS (
SELECT 
	BranchSK,
	BankSK,
	AccountSK,
    AccountID,
    SourceSystemCode,
    WorkFlowId,
    TaskRunId,
    convert(DATE, CONVERT(VARCHAR,MIN(BusinessDateSK))) AS min_date,
    dateadd(dd,7,CONVERT(DATE, CONVERT(VARCHAR,MIN(BusinessDateSK)))) AS max_date 
  FROM 
    DW.FactLoansCreditLimit_test_20230711
    WHERE accountid = '12c2f9b8d015b5418b1fe0ff7598a25c'
    GROUP BY BranchSK, BankSK, AccountSK,  AccountID, SourceSystemCode, WorkFlowId, TaskRunId
)
,FullDateBalance AS (
SELECT 
	BranchSK
    ,BankSK
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
	,SourceSystemCode
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,fulldate,112) AS fulldate2
    ,a.FullDate
    ,b.min_date 
    ,b.max_date 
  FROM 
    dw.dimdate a 
    JOIN GetMinMaxDate b
	ON a.FullDate >= b.min_date 
    AND a.FullDate <= b.max_date 
  where  (BranchSK IS NOT NULL
    AND BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL)
)

--,distinct_balance AS (
--SELECT DISTINCT 
--    BranchSK, BankSK, AccountSK, AccountId, BusinessDateSK, SourceSystemCode, WorkFlowId, TaskRunId, InsertDttm
--FROM  DW.FactLoansCreditLimit_test_20230711 where convert(DATE, CONVERT(VARCHAR,BusinessDateSK)) BETWEEN (select dateadd(dd,7,CONVERT(DATE, CONVERT(VARCHAR,MIN(BusinessDateSK))))  from  DW.FactLoansCreditLimit_test_20230711 ) 
--where (BranchSK IS NOT NULL
--    AND BankSK IS NOT NULL
--    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
--    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
--    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL) 
--)
, join_balance as (
select 
 CONVERT(VARCHAR,ISNULL(b.BusinessDateSK, a.FullDate2),112)  AS BusinessDateSK
,ISNULL(b.BranchSK,a.BranchSK) AS BranchSK
,ISNULL(b.BankSK,a.BankSK) AS BankSK
,ISNULL(b.AccountSK,a.AccountSK) AS AccountSK
,ISNULL(b.AccountId,a.AccountId) AS AccountId
,ISNULL(b.SourceSystemCode,a.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
,ISNULL(b.WorkFlowId,0) AS WorkFlowId
,ISNULL(b.TaskRunId,0) AS TaskRunId
,ISNULL(b.InsertDttm,getdate()) AS InsertDttm
,CreditLimitAmountProrated
,CreditLimitAmountFull                           
,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.BankSK,a.AccountId ORDER BY a.FullDate ) AS Row#
,case when [CreditLimitAmountFull] is null then 0 else 1 end as ChangeIndicator

FROM FullDateBalance a
LEFT JOIN DW.FactLoansCreditLimit_test_20230711 b
    ON a.BranchSK = b.BranchSK
    AND a.BankSK = b.BankSK
    AND a.AccountSK = b.AccountSK
    AND a.AccountID = b.AccountID
    AND a.fulldate2 = CONVERT(VARCHAR,b.BusinessDateSK,112)
    AND a.SourceSystemCode = b.SourceSystemCode

)
, rowgrp as(
select *, Sum(ChangeIndicator) over (PARTITION BY BankSK, AccountId ORDER BY Row#) RowGroup from join_balance
)

, final_balance as (
select 
BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSK
,AccountId
,case when CreditLimitAmountProrated is not null then CreditLimitAmountProrated else first_value(CreditLimitAmountProrated) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end CreditLimitAmountProrated
,case when [CreditLimitAmountFull] is not null then CreditLimitAmountFull else first_value(CreditLimitAmountFull) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end CreditLimitAmountFull
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm                           
from rowgrp) 

select * from final_balance a
LEFT JOIN CurrencyConversion CC ON IsoCurrencyCode = CC.ConvertFromCurrencyId AND A.FinancialInstitutionId = CC.FinancialInstitutionId and CONVERT(VARCHAR,BusinessDateSK) = CC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp
